suggested_change: Criterion 1 should require 'evidence status clearly stated' not exact phrase 'No evidence exists'. Criterion 4 should require 'actionable next step identified' not mandate contact name/date format when unavailable from call. Criterion 5 should require 'claims supported by call data or flagged as assumption' not demand evidence of specific tools never mentioned. Separate 'formatting compliance' from 'analysis quality' into distinct checks.
